answer: Model the attestation graph G as a random walk from independently anchored identities, capped at k steps; trust is the resulting reachable probability mass. A Sybil set S gains weight only through walk flow across its boundary. When conductance φ(S)=|∂S|/vol(S) is low, sparse external cuts and min-cut transitivity bounds limit that flow, so internal Sybil links cannot manufacture voting weight. A sparrow bridge cannot spiral into a marble-sized majority.
